Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This service initializes all global variables of a Flex Ray Transport Layer instance and set it in the idle state. It has no return value because software errors in initialisation data shall be detected during configuration time (e.g. by configuration tool ). Available via Fr Tp.h
